notes: Source ages are embedded; the simulator needs no runtime network request.
Formation phases, quoted age uncertainty and approximate point examples are labeled separately.
The clock reports scale arithmetic, rather than asserting that scientific ages are precise to hundredths of a cosmic second.
The rounded universe-age reference is held fixed; its uncertainty is not propagated.
Legacy selection identifiers are retained for saved-state compatibility.

events.name: Big Bang
events.basis: Start boundary of the 13.8-billion-year teaching scale.
events.source: NASA · Big Bang and the early universe

events.name: Neutral hydrogen
events.basis: Approximately 380,000 years after the Big Bang; the transition took time.
events.source: NASA · Big Bang and the early universe

events.name: First stars
events.basis: Illustrative epoch: approximately 200 million years after the Big Bang.

events.name: Milky Way thick disk
events.basis: Formation phase: about 13–8 billion years ago. The marker is the approximate 11-billion-year peak. The band is a period of growth.

events.name: Solar System
events.basis: Approximate formation age: 4.6 billion years ago.
events.source: NASA · How our Solar System formed

events.name: Early life evidence
events.basis: Approximate age of the Dresser Formation evidence: 3.48 billion years.
events.source: Djokic et al. 2017 · Early life evidence

events.name: Eukaryote fossils
events.basis: Approximate age of the Roper Group fossil record: 1.5 billion years.

events.name: Cambrian boundary
events.basis: Published boundary age: 538.8 ± 0.6 million years. The band shows the quoted numerical age uncertainty.

events.name: Early dinosaur fossils
events.basis: Approximate fossil age example: 230 million years.

events.name: Human fossils
events.basis: Published weighted age: 315 ± 34 thousand years. The band shows the quoted dating uncertainty.
events.source: Richter et al. 2017 · Jebel Irhoud dating

events.name: Present boundary
events.basis: End boundary of the teaching scale: zero seconds remaining.
